episodeTitle.en: Vision, conviction, and hype: How to build 0 to 1 inside a company | Mihika Kapoor (Product, Figma)
episodeTitle.zh: 《愿景、信念与炒作：如何在公司内部从0到1打造创新》 | 米希卡·卡普尔（Mihika Kapoor，Figma产品经理）

guestBioOfficial.en: Mihika Kapoor is a design-engineer-PM hybrid at Figma, where she was an early PM on FigJam and is now spearheading development on a new product at the company that’s coming out this June. She’s known as the go-to person at Figma for leading new 0-to-1 products, and, as you’ll hear in our conversation, beloved by everyone she works with. Her background includes founding Design Nation, a national nonprofit focused on democratizing design education for undergraduates; spearheading product launches at Meta; and community building within the NYC AI startup scene. In our conversation, we discuss: • How to effectively take ideas from 0 to 1 at larger companies
guestBioOfficial.zh: 米希卡·卡普尔（Mihika Kapoor）是Figma公司的设计工程师兼产品经理三位一体人才。她曾是FigJam产品的早期产品经理，如今正牵头开发公司将于今年6月推出的新产品。在Figma内部，她被视为引领新产品从0到1开发的核心人物，正如你将在我们的对谈中听到的，她深受同事们的喜爱。她的职业经历包括创立全国性非营利组织"设计国度"（Design Nation），致力于为大学生普及设计教育；在Meta公司主导产品发布；以及参与纽约市人工智能初创企业社区建设。在对谈中，我们将探讨：• 在大型公司如何有效地将创意从0到1落地

title.en: Vision, conviction, and hype: How to build 0 to 1 inside a company | Mihika Kapoor (Product, Figma)
title.zh: 《愿景、信念与炒作：如何在公司内部从0到1打造创新》 | 米希卡·卡普尔（Mihika Kapoor，Figma产品经理）

summary.en: Mihika argues a PM's scope should be the whole world, with nothing off-limits, and that prototyping before a project is greenlit builds shared vision. She shares Figma's "Maker Week" hackathon as a way to give people space for wildly ambitious ideas. The episode is a master class in vision-setting and entrepreneurial culture.
summary.zh: 米希卡认为，PM 的视野应当是"全世界"，没有什么是禁区；在项目获批前就做设计与原型，能建立共同愿景。她分享了 Figma 的 "Maker Week" 内部黑客松，作为给员工空间去追求狂野想法的做法。本期是关于"设定愿景与创业文化"的大师课。
